prompt.name: Cavalry
prompt.look: A napoleonic-era cavalry trooper on a dark brown horse with a black mane and tail. The rider has dark side-whiskers and a moustache, a tall black shako hat with a cream pom-pom on top, a cream rope cord looped across the front and an oval brass plate, a red tunic with white crossed belts and brass buttons, cream breeches and tall black boots, and carries a curved steel sabre. The horse wears a black saddle cloth edged in cream under a brown leather saddle, with a rolled cloak behind the saddle, and a brown leather bridle with brass rings.
prompt.team_area: the rider's tunic and the saddle cloth
prompt.coat: The horse is a dark, cool brown (about #5A3E2B) with a black mane and tail (about #1E1A18) and dark legs. It must not look red: no reddish, mahogany, rust or bay tones anywhere on the horse, because the game recolours red.
prompt.identity: the same rider, shako, whiskers, red tunic with white crossed belts, cream breeches, boots and sabre, and the same dark cool-brown horse with its black mane and tail, black saddle cloth, rolled cloak and bridle
prompt.weapon_pose: He holds the sabre upright in his right hand, the blade pointing up and slightly forward.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, sabre upright; (2) he raises the sabre high above his head; (3) wind-up: arm drawn back behind the shoulder, body twisting; (4) the cut: arm and sabre sweeping forward and down to the right; (5) full extension, the blade low in front of the horse's head; (6) recover to ready.
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a snapped sabre blade and a torn bridle
